events.description: A man lies motionless on the ground, appearing unconscious or severely injured, while another person's hand is visible near his head/shoulder in early frames (f0–f2), suggesting he was struck down and left helpless.

A large crowd surges violently against a line of soldiers holding anti-riot barricades; people are pushing, climbing over, and being beaten back with batons, resulting in multiple individuals falling and being subdued—indicating collective violent unrest and group clashes.

Direct physical combat occurs between civilians and soldiers: individuals are seen grabbing, striking, and wrestling with soldiers at the barricade line (e.g., f10–f15), satisfying the definition of mutual physical combat in localized engagements within the larger riot.
A man in a brown coat engages in close-quarters physical combat with a soldier in uniform, involving grappling, weapon disarming, and forceful control.
The man in the brown coat subdues the soldier, who is now restrained and helpless, and presses a pistol against his head/temple while the soldier grimaces in pain and fear.

A person in a brown coat holds a pistol to the head/neck of a seated man in a military uniform, who is visibly distressed and restrained; the gun is pressed against his neck while he grimaces in pain/fear.

Physical struggle involving weapon-assisted coercion: one individual uses a pistol to press against another’s neck while gripping their arm/chest, indicating active physical domination and resistance (visible via facial strain and body tension).

After the gun is removed, the aggressor (in brown coat) leans over the victim, who remains slumped in the chair; the posture suggests continued intimidation or post-assault control, with the victim appearing subdued and injured.

A man in a military uniform is being choked or strangled by another person's hand gripping his neck; his face shows extreme pain and distress, eyes closed, teeth bared, indicating a violent assault on a restrained or helpless victim.

A dense, agitated crowd surges violently; individuals are pushing, shoving, raising fists, and some appear to be fighting or being restrained. Soldiers in uniform are seen actively engaging with the crowd, attempting to control or disperse them through physical force, consistent with collective violent unrest.

A large, densely packed crowd of civilians is engaged in violent, chaotic confrontation with uniformed soldiers; people are pushing, shoving, grabbing, and being forcibly restrained or beaten by soldiers using batons and physical force, consistent with a riot or suppression of a mass uprising.

Multiple instances of mutual physical combat occur between civilians and soldiers: civilians grab soldiers' arms and weapons, soldiers strike and wrestle with individuals, and there is sustained hand-to-hand struggle throughout the sequence.

Soldiers are seen repeatedly striking and overpowering individuals who appear subdued or unable to resist (e.g., person bent over at f4, woman crying surrounded at f5–f10), indicating targeted abuse of vulnerable persons within the crowd.

A man lies on the ground, apparently injured or unconscious, while multiple people surround and physically interact with him—some appear to be restraining or pressing down on him, consistent with abuse of a helpless victim.
A dense, agitated crowd with raised fists, shouting faces, and chaotic movement suggests collective violent unrest; individuals are pushing and jostling aggressively before the man falls.

A person lies on the ground while multiple individuals surround and physically assault them; hands are seen striking, grabbing, and pressing down on the prone individual across all frames, indicating sustained abuse of a helpless victim.

The crowd rapidly swells from ~5 to >20 people, with increasing density, chaotic movement, and some individuals raising arms or holding objects (e.g., frame f15 shows possible baton-like object), suggesting escalation into collective violent unrest centered on the abuse event.

A dense crowd is engaged in intense, chaotic physical struggle; multiple individuals are seen grappling, pushing, and striking each other in a confined space, with visible motion blur and shifting positions indicating active mutual combat.

At least one individual (wearing a pink/red patterned top) appears pinned or restrained on the ground by multiple others, with hands pressing down and limited ability to move—suggesting targeted subjugation rather than symmetrical combat.

A dense crowd is engaged in intense, chaotic physical struggle from an overhead perspective; individuals are seen grappling, pushing, and striking one another amid smoke/dust, with visible arm movements consistent with punching and wrestling.
